mapper.select: SELECT oid, doc_state AS docState FROM ( SELECT oid, doc_state, doc_version, doc_iteration FROM caoe_doc WHERE doc_number = #{docNumber} ORDER BY doc_version DESC, TO_NUMBER(doc_iteration) DESC NULLS LAST ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
SELECT pp_state FROM CAOE_PP WHERE PP_NUMBER = #{accno} AND PP_VERSION = #{version} AND ROWNUM = 1
SELECT op_link FROM CAOE_OP WHERE OP_NUMBER = #{number} AND OP_VERSION = #{version}
SELECT oid FROM CAOE_OP WHERE OP_NUMBER = #{number} AND OP_VERSION = #{version}
